newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell mulls sale of CEPA.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell mulls sale of CEPA.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd is considering sale of part or all of its stake in Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA) but no decision had yet been made, the companies said in a joint statement issued through the stock exchange on Monday.

Hopewell confirmed it had received a number of approaches from independent third parties relating to the possible acquisition from Hopewell of part of or all of its stake in CEPA, amounting to 60.4 percent of CEPA's issued share.
The statement said discussions between Hopewell and a number of independent third parties were continuing but no decision had been made by Hopewell so far.

Local newspapers reported over the weekend that a U.S. company, General Public Utilities Corp, said it was considering purchasing part of CEPA but did not give details or the size of the intended purchase.
